تتداخلون (form VI)
# تَتَدَاخَلُونَ (tatadāḵalūna) /ta.ta.daː.xa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# تُتَدَاخَلُونَ (tutadāḵalūna) /tu.ta.daː.xa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
